_comment: Items whose stat effect is one of several mutually exclusive variants,
and items whose bonus scales with a countable game quantity.
Both are hand-entered from the item's Effects section because the
structure only exists in prose. Summing a variant list would describe a
state that never occurs in game (you have one Purity colour, not four),
and treating a per-unit bonus as a constant is just wrong.
'variants': pick exactly one. The first is the default shown.
'scaled':   mods are granted PER UNIT of 'quantity', capped at 'max'.

Purity.source: Effects: Red/Blue/Yellow/Orange aura, one at a time

Abyss.source: Effects: locust damage multiplier keyed to absorbed item quality

Playdough Cookie.source: Effects: each tear rolls a colour; Red grants 2x damage

Money = Power.source: Adds 0.04 damage for every Penny Isaac has; caps at +3.96 at 99 coins

Brittle Bones.source: Each Bone Heart lost adds a permanent +0.4 fire rate, which can break the tear fire rate cap

False PHD.source: Grants +0.6 damage for each stat down pill (and +1.2 per horse pill) Isaac has taken

Bloody Gust.source: Both effects stack up to six times, for a total of +1.02 speed and +3 fire rate

Keeper's Sack.source: Every 3 coins spent grants in a cycle: +0.5 damage, then +0.25 range, then +0.03 speed (averaged per step)
